notes: Transcribed from the PWD Schedule of Rates 2022 (Revised), Part A: Civil Works (16th edition, revised, effective 23 February 2023) on 2026-10-21. The four official price zones (Dhaka and Mymensingh / Chattogram and Sylhet / Khulna, Barisal and Gopalgonj / Rajshahi and Rangpur) become each line's regional multipliers. These are works rates: the contractor's profit, overhead and VAT are listed separately in the book and are not included. Stone chips added 2026-11-09 from the same copy (hash checked). Formwork (steel, per sqm) and rebar fixing (derived) added 2026-11-09; the book has no man-day norms, it prices works as composite rates. A candidate card until a human marks it active.
